# prepare_inputs { #valley_floor.prepare_inputs }

```python
prepare_inputs(dem, flowlines, params=PreprocessingParameters())
```

Prepare hydrological inputs for valley floor delineation using streamkit.

Runs the full preprocessing pipeline: channel head detection, flow routing,
network extraction, reach segmentation, headwater pruning, subbasin
delineation, HAND computation, and cross section generation.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                    | Description                                                                            | Default                     |
|-----------|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| dem       | xr.DataArray            | Digital elevation model.                                                               | _required_                  |
| flowlines | gpd.GeoDataFrame        | Stream network as a GeoDataFrame of directed LineStrings, from upstream to downstream. | _required_                  |
| params    | PreprocessingParameters | Preprocessing parameters. Defaults to PreprocessingParameters().                       | `PreprocessingParameters()` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | Dictionary with keys: - channel_network: Full labeled stream network raster including headwaters. - channel_network_gdf: Full stream network as a GeoDataFrame. - trunk_network: Stream network with headwaters removed (raster). - trunk_network_gdf: Stream network with headwaters removed (GeoDataFrame). - subbasins: Raster of subbasin labels, one per trunk reach. - hand: Height Above Nearest Drainage raster. - xs_coords: Cross section sample points as a GeoDataFrame. |
